cases.question: What is the specific monthly interest rate applied to overdue balances under the Halcyon Biotech master services agreement?
cases.gold_quote: Amounts unpaid after that date accrue interest at 3.0% per month.

cases.question: How much advance warning must Kestrel Analytics provide before bringing in a new third-party processor?
cases.gold_quote: Kestrel Analytics may engage sub-processors on 28 days prior notice to Customer, during which Customer may object on reasonable data protection grounds.

cases.question: How much advance warning is required for Northwind Systems to end their Master Services Agreement without cause?
cases.gold_quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on 25 days prior written notice.

cases.question: What is the specific monthly interest rate applied to overdue balances under the Everly Robotics MSA-EVR-Everly agreement?
cases.gold_quote: Amounts unpaid after that date accrue interest at 2.25% per month.

cases.question: What is the mandatory timeframe for Brightmoor Health to provide a response when a Severity One issue is reported?
cases.gold_quote: Brightmoor Health shall acknowledge a Severity One incident within 55 minutes and a Severity Two incident within 6 hours, in each case during the support window of 10am to 10pm local time.

cases.question: For how many days does the Kestrel Analytics platform warranty remain active after the contract starts?
cases.gold_quote: Kestrel Analytics warrants the Platform will perform materially in accordance with its documentation for 75 days following the Effective Date.

cases.question: How many days of advance notice must Halcyon Biotech provide if they wish to end the Master Services Agreement without cause?
cases.gold_quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on 115 days prior written notice.

cases.question: What is the required response time for Northwind Systems when a Severity One issue is reported?
cases.gold_quote: Northwind Systems shall acknowledge a Severity One incident within 25 minutes and a Severity Two incident within 3 hours, in each case during the support window of 7am to 7pm local time.

cases.question: How long does the Ironvale Mining confidentiality obligation persist following the conclusion of the contract?
cases.gold_quote: Each party shall protect the other's Confidential Information with no less than reasonable care, and these obligations survive for 13 years after termination.

cases.question: What is the specific timeframe within which Brightmoor Health must be notified of a third-party intellectual property claim to trigger their indemnification obligation?
cases.gold_quote: Brightmoor Health shall indemnify Customer against third party claims that the Platform infringes a patent or copyright, provided Customer notifies Brightmoor Health within 17 days of becoming aware of the claim and grants sole control of the defence.

cases.question: What is the minimum amount of professional indemnity insurance that Northwind Systems is required to hold under the Master Services Agreement?
cases.gold_quote: Northwind Systems shall maintain commercial general liability cover of not less than USD 2 million and professional indemnity cover of not less than USD 2 million throughout the Term, and shall furnish certificates on request.

cases.question: What is the specific uptime guarantee percentage provided by Granite Payments in their Master Services Agreement?
cases.gold_quote: Granite Payments shall make the Platform available 99.63% of the time each calendar month, excluding maintenance notified 11 business days in advance.

cases.question: What is the specific timeframe for Brightmoor Health to provide notification before implementing a price hike during a renewal period?
cases.gold_quote: Fees may be increased once per renewal term on 70 days written notice.
